method: Viewed every six-frame contact sheet on both light and dark backgrounds. Rechecked corrected caption crops for 02,04,05,06,08 and final sheets for 01,03,07,09.
limitation: Static contact-sheet-only visual review. Does not validate real-time playback, encoded WebP frame timing, flicker, smooth loop motion, WhatsApp import, or technical file compliance. Contact sheet tiles display each 512px frame reduced to 256px.
